title: The Rewind: You Can’t Predict. You Can Prepare.

thesis: Howard Marks argues that while one cannot predict specific market events or psychological shifts, one can prepare by identifying where the market stands in its cycle to determine vulnerability to shocks. He emphasizes that psychology dominates short-term market outcomes, making it impossible to predict future sentiment but possible to identify current extremes where the probability of success is high, whereas the market's intermediate-term direction is best determined by its current cyclical position.
